incident.observed: Google social initiation returned 503 AUTH_UNAVAILABLE before Google navigation.
incident.temporaryRecovery: Promoted known-working compatible source deployment dpl_BSoaf6YoP2nKq7MCidzdetUFa8pD; Google initiation returned 200 and actual Google sign-in reached settings.
incident.rootCause: Unconfirmed; the original deployment later returned 200 on direct recheck. A rejected SDK initialization context is independently proven to remain cached, but is not established as the original incident cause.

fix.failedInitialization: Discard only the matching failed auth singleton and close its own pool. A later independent request may initialize fresh.
fix.diagnostics: Allowlisted phase/error class/code/cause only; no raw messages, stack, SQL, request fields, cookies or credentials.
fix.availability: Session/database/key-service failures return503; explicit invalid/expired/revoked/unverified credentials retain401/403. Existing browser session remains on temporary failure.

validation.liveGoogleSignIn: PASS on temporarily restored compatible deployment

testData.finalState: Archived; original source and all holdings unchanged.

limitations: Mobile browser viewport emulation, not a physical phone.
Permanent cause of the initial transient 503 remains unconfirmed.
Final main-branch deployment verification will be appended after the follow-up fix is merged.

mainIntermediateDeployment.note: An initial reload briefly returned to sign-in; inspection found broad infrastructure-error-to401 conversion, addressed by the availability fix recorded above.
